title: Audit & Tax Associate – CA Fresher / CA Finalist
description:
**Company Description** 
 CA KRUPA PANCHAL \& CO. is an accounting firm based in Gandhinagar, Gujarat, India. The firm provides professional services in accounting, taxation, and audit to a diverse range of clients. Located in a key commercial area of Gandhinagar, the firm offers exposure to varied business sectors and compliance requirements. Team members can expect a structured environment focused on professional ethics, learning, and practical application of accounting standards. The firm values accuracy, responsibility, and continuous professional growth.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time on\-site role based in Gandhinagar for CA Freshers and CA Finalists. The role involves assisting with bookkeeping, preparation and review of financial statements, and supporting statutory and tax audits under guidance of senior team members. Responsibilities include working on tax computations and returns, supporting GST and income tax compliance, and preparing working papers and documentation. The role also includes liaising with clients for data collection, clarifications, and follow\-ups, as well as maintaining organized records and files. Candidates will participate in research on accounting, tax, and regulatory updates and contribute to internal process improvements.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Currently a CA Fresher, CA Intern (Articleship), or CA Finalist with a strong interest in accounting, audit, and taxation.
* Solid understanding of basic accounting principles, financial statements, and bookkeeping practices.
* Knowledge of Indian taxation, including income tax and GST; willingness to learn and stay updated on regulatory changes.
* Comfort with MS Excel, accounting software, and general computer applications used in professional practice.
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and ability to work with numerical data accurately.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills for client interaction and documentation.
* Ability to work on\-site in Gandhinagar, manage deadlines, and collaborate within a professional team environment.
* Commitment to professional ethics, confidentiality, and continuous learning; prior internship or articleship experience is an advantage.
